biography.bio:
A doctor who joined to keep the team in one piece - and who drives as hard as any of them.

Masks: Streamer, New Streamer (wearing Streamer).

Vehicles: @UUID[Compendium.essence20-homebrew-starter.mask_vehicles.Actor.TPhhcijEpnUp7w1r]{Firefly}, @UUID[Compendium.essence20-homebrew-starter.mask_vehicles.Actor.5yxFgp6HoXsvOnYa]{Fireforce}, @UUID[Compendium.essence20-homebrew-starter.mask_vehicles.Actor.K7dyyoAw5Olr6CUj]{Fireforce Trike}.

M.A.S.K. - M.A.S.K. homebrew; stats built with the Threat Builder (Field Guide rules).

system.description:
Sprays sticky glue, fire-smothering foam or a slick of oil.

Julio Lopez's mask. Bonded to the first agent who puts it on: for them, it gives +1 Toughness and its power works a number of times per scene equal to their Speed. One mask at a time.

options.label: Oil slick: enemies within 15 ft knocked Prone

automation.notes: Glue (Restrained until the end of the target's next turn) and Oil (Prone) roll against Evasion. Foam just posts to chat - which fire goes out is up to the GM. Speed uses per scene and +1 Toughness, only for the bonded wearer (Power Gear: bonded, mask slot).

system.description:
The upgraded Streamer: its glue, plus a holographic double.

Julio Lopez's mask. Bonded to the first agent who puts it on: for them, it gives +1 Toughness and its power works a number of times per scene equal to their Speed. One mask at a time.

automation.notes: Rolls against the targets and posts Apply Damage buttons (x degrees of success) and any Condition on a hit. Holo-Double: +2 Evasion until the end of the wearer's next turn. Speed uses per scene and +1 Toughness, only for the bonded wearer (Power Gear: bonded, mask slot).

system.description:
You know your ride like your own hands. A vehicle you are driving has +1 Evasion and Edge on its Driving Tests.

M.A.S.K. homebrew.

automation.notes: Automatic: the vehicle you drive gets +1 Evasion, and its Driving Tests have Edge.

system.description:
You and your mask are one. Rolls made with your mask's power are upshifted once.

M.A.S.K. homebrew.

automation.notes: Automatic: an attack from one of your mask's Use buttons is upshifted once.
